requirements: The one actual service loop executes uv_fs_read/open/close with non-null real callbacks. Commands synchronously return the actual libuv admission status.

Successful admission acquires one native in-flight request entitlement and queues exactly one completion. Immediate rejection returns the actual request to its caller without a queued event or pending counter increment.
The actual uv_fs_t, path and backing entitlement survive native callback publication until explicit FSReqAfterScope cleanup; native release is abandonment fallback only.
Service stop calls actual uv_cancel for every still-pending FS request, keeps actual callbacks draining until uv_run completes, then joins. No guest callback or VM value exists on the worker.
Open descriptors are returned as actual native integers. uv_fs_req_cleanup does not close a descriptor; actual FileHandle ownership remains the separate derived consumer.
The existing twelve TCP declarations and all TCP actor algorithms are unchanged. The generic Hub/service extraction and actual FSReq dispatch adapter are separate pending source slices.
